escena: SCENE (staged, Efeonce studio at night, the second the campaign dashboard turns green): a Chilean account director in his mid thirties, short dark hair and trimmed beard, wearing the navy Efeonce softshell jacket over the navy Efeonce polo with the Efeonce lanyard, badge card turned away and unreadable, stands in front of a large wall screen and has just spun around toward the camera with a wide, genuine grin, one hand still raised toward the screen behind him, holding a plain azure-blue (#0375DB) marker. The wall screen behind him is the brightest thing in the frame and backlights him with a cool white-blue rim; a warm low key light from the left lifts his face. The screen shows only a soft abstract rising line, no readable text or numbers. Low camera, a clear low angle looking up at him. He fills the LOWER 60% of the frame from the waist up, his head just above the middle. The dark ceiling above the screen is calm, evenly shadowed and empty. 28mm f/2.

lecho.objeto: the dark edge of a table right at the lens, dissolved into blur and outside every beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed dark ceiling above the screen
